title: Origin story: Tidecaller Yara
description: Yara was a fisher's daughter who learned the tide-tables before her letters, and noticed the tides listened back. She became the Tidecaller, negotiating with the moon on behalf of coastal towns: higher tides for the harvest, lower for the building season. The moon drives a hard bargain, but Yara has never lost one.
